chapterInfo.content:
24
1Na Bileam hunuu sɛ asɔ AWURADE ani sɛ ɔhyira Israel no, wankɔ abisa sɛdeɛ ɔkɔɔ kane no, na mmom ɔde n’ani kyerɛɛ ɛserɛ no so. 2Na Bileam maa n’ani so, na ɔhunuu Israel sɛ wɔgu hɔ mmusua mmusua; na Nyankopɔn honhom baa ne so, 3#1 Sa 9.9 na ɔkasae sɛ:
Beor ba Bileam asɛm a wanya sɛ ɔreka,
ɔbarima a n’ani hunu adeɛ yie no asɛm a wanya,
4 # Yes 50.4 deɛ ɔte Nyankopɔn nsɛm no na ɔreka yi,
deɛ ɔhunu Tweaduampɔn anisoadeɛ,
na ɔrehwe ase a, wɔte n’ani soɔ no:
5Sɛdeɛ wo ntomadan si yɛ fɛ, O Yakob,
wo tenabea no, O Israel!
6Ɛyere sɛ asubɔnka,
sɛ asuo ho nturo,
te sɛ pɛprɛ nnua a AWURADE atɛ,
te sɛ nsuo ho ntweneduro.
7Na ne mmokiti mu nsuo bu so,
na n’asefoɔ tena nsuo pii mu.
Ne hene so sene Agag,
na wɔbɛma n’ahennie so.
8Onyankopɔn na ɔyii no firii Misraim,
n’ahoɔden te sɛ ɛkoɔ deɛ.
Ɔbɛmene amanaman a wɔyɛ n’atamfo,
na wadwerɛ wɔn nnompe,
na ɔde n’agyan awowɔ wɔn.
9 # Num 23.24; Gye 49.9; 12.3 Ɔkoto, ɔbutu sɛ gyata ne gyatabereɛ,
hwan na ɔbɛma no asɔreɛ?
Nhyira ne wɔn a wɔhyira woɔ,
na nnome ne wɔn a wɔdome woɔ.
Balak gya no kwan
10Ɛnna Balak bo fuu Bileam, na ɔbɔɔ ne nsam; na Balak ka kyerɛɛ Bileam sɛ: M’atamfoɔ nnome nti na mehyiaa woɔ, na hwɛ, nhyira na woahyira wɔn mprɛnsa yi. 11Na afei dwane kɔ deɛ wofire! Mekaa sɛ anka mɛhyɛ wo animuonyam, na hwɛ, AWURADE asi w’animuonyam ho kwan. 12Na Bileam ka kyerɛɛ Balak sɛ: Manka mankyerɛ w’abɔfoɔ a wosomaa wɔn me nkyɛn no nso sɛ: 13#Num 22.18 Sɛ Balak de ne fie a dwetɛ ne sika ahyɛ mu ma, ma me mpo a, merentumi mentra AWURADE asɛm memfiri m’akomam menkɔyɛ papa anaa bɔne; deɛ AWURADE bɛka no, ɛno na mɛka? 14Na afei, hwɛ, merekɔ me man mu: Bra na menkasa menkyerɛ wo deɛ ɔman yi bɛyɛ wo man nna a ɛdi akyire no mu.
15 # Num 24.3-4 Na ɔkasaa sɛ:
Beor ba Bileam asɛm a wanya sɛ ɔreka,
ɔbarima a n’ani hunu adeɛ yie no asɛm a wanya,
16deɛ ɔte Nyankopɔn nsɛm
a ɔhunu ɔsorosoroni no ho nimdeɛ no,
deɛ ɔhunu Tweaduampɔn anisoadeɛ
na ɔrehwe ase a, wɔte n’ani soɔ no:
17 # Mat 2.2; Luka 1.78; 2 Sa 8.2; Amos 2.2 Mehu no, nso ɛnyɛ seesei,
mehwɛ no, nso ɔmmɛn:
Nsoromma bɛpue Yakob mu,
na ahempoma bɛfiri Israel mu asɔre,
na wadwerɛ Moab afanan nyinaa
na wabubu ɔko huuyɛ mma no nyinaa.
18 # 2 Sa 8.14; Amos 9.11-12 Na ɔbɛfa Edom adi so,
na wafa n’atamfo asase Seir adi so,
na Israel bɛyɛ ahoɔdenneɛ ara.
19 # Mika 5.2, 8-9 Na obi a ɔfiri Yakob mu bɛdi tumi,
na wasɛe wɔn a wɔaka wɔ kuro no mu no.
20 # Eks 17.14 Afei ɔhwɛɛ Amalek na ɔtoaa ne kasa no so sɛ:
Amanaman mu dikanfo ne Amalek,
nanso n’awieeɛ bɛwie no ɔsɛeɛ mu.
21 # 1 Sa 15.6; Oba 3 Na ɔhwɛɛ Kenifoɔ toaa ne kasa no so kaa sɛ:
Wo tenabea si hɔ pintinn,
na wode wo pirebuo asie ɔbotan mu;
22nanso wɔbɛsɛe Kain,
de akɔsi sɛ Asur bɛfa wo nnommum.
23Na ɔwiee ne kasa no so kaa sɛ:
Buei, sɛ Onyankopɔn reyɛ yei a,
hwan na ɔbɛnya nkwa?
24Na ahyɛn bɛfiri Kitim fam aba,
na wɔabɛbrɛ Asur ase abrɛ Eber ase;
na ɔno ara nso, awie no ɔsɛeɛ mu.
25 # Num 31.8, 16 Ɛnna Bileam sɔreeɛ, na ɔsii mu sane kɔɔ n’atenaeɛ; na Balak nso kɔɔ ne kwan.

Na Bileam hunuu sɛ asɔ AWURADE ani sɛ ɔhyira Israel no, wankɔ abisa sɛdeɛ ɔkɔɔ kane no, na mmom ɔde n’ani kyerɛɛ ɛserɛ no so. Na Bileam maa n’ani so, na ɔhunuu Israel sɛ wɔgu hɔ mmusua mmusua; na Nyankopɔn honhom baa ne so, na ɔkasae sɛ:

sɛ asuo ho nturo,
te sɛ pɛprɛ nnua a AWURADE atɛ,
te sɛ nsuo ho ntweneduro.
Na ne mmokiti mu nsuo bu so,
na n’asefoɔ tena nsuo pii mu.
Ne hene so sene Agag,
na wɔbɛma n’ahennie so.
Onyankopɔn na ɔyii no firii Misraim,

Ɔbɛmene amanaman a wɔyɛ n’atamfo,

Mekaa sɛ anka mɛhyɛ wo animuonyam, na hwɛ, AWURADE asi w’animuonyam ho kwan. Na Bileam ka kyerɛɛ Balak sɛ: Manka mankyerɛ w’abɔfoɔ a wosomaa wɔn me nkyɛn no nso sɛ: Sɛ Balak de ne fie a dwetɛ ne sika ahyɛ mu ma, ma me mpo a, merentumi mentra AWURADE asɛm memfiri m’akomam menkɔyɛ papa anaa bɔne; deɛ AWURADE bɛka no, ɛno na mɛka? Na afei, hwɛ, merekɔ me man mu: Bra na menkasa menkyerɛ wo deɛ ɔman yi bɛyɛ wo man nna a ɛdi akyire no mu.
Na ɔkasaa sɛ:
Beor ba Bileam asɛm a wanya sɛ ɔreka,
ɔbarima a n’ani hunu adeɛ yie no asɛm a wanya,
deɛ ɔte Nyankopɔn nsɛm
a ɔhunu ɔsorosoroni no ho nimdeɛ no,
deɛ ɔhunu Tweaduampɔn anisoadeɛ
na ɔrehwe ase a, wɔte n’ani soɔ no:
Mehu no, nso ɛnyɛ seesei,
mehwɛ no, nso ɔmmɛn:

Na ɔbɛfa Edom adi so,

Afei ɔhwɛɛ Amalek na ɔtoaa ne kasa no so sɛ:

Na ɔhwɛɛ Kenifoɔ toaa ne kasa no so kaa sɛ:

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
